diagnostic: TZ #76-FIX13 production bracket partition proof and matchup win-rate semantics

partitionVerification.statusMeaning: PROVEN_ON_SAMPLE means empirical additivity of the production bracket groups in this sample only; it is not a general STRATZ API contract.

allEnumPartitionCheckFix12.note: Historical FIX12 all-enum check (UNCALIBRATED/FILTERED/ALL included), kept separate and unchanged.

winsAverageSemantics.statusMeaning: Every relevant row is valid and matches winCount / matchCount within its reported rounding.
winsAverageSemantics.schemaContract: NOT_ESTABLISHED — GraphQL description for winsAverage is null.
winsAverageSemantics.rowsBelowFieldPrecisionNote: A value such as 0.46 may be a 3-decimal 0.460 with the trailing zero dropped by JSON; it is checked against its own (looser) reported precision and also against the field precision below.
winsAverageSemantics.rowSetNote: Same pair-specific row set as FIX12 winCountSemantics: every present, non-duplicate directed row across all 10 filters. Identical responses from different filters are counted per filter.

directionConsistencySummary.note: Descriptive contribution analysis only. Rank-group decomposition does not establish the cause of the reverse-pair asymmetry.

reverseDirectionConsistency.note: No schema-level invariant requires reverse-direction equality (FIX12).

knownLimitations: Schema description is null; meaning is inferred only from the matchLimit argument description.
Additivity is empirical for 8 pairs × 4 weeks and production brackets only.

productionReverseWinSum.description: winsAtoB + winsBtoA − mean(gamesAtoB, gamesBtoA) on production rows; 0 if winCount is heroId1 wins and both directions count the same matches.

winCount.semanticNote: winCount is the numerator of winsAverage on every sampled row, and reverse-direction wins approximately complement each other, which is consistent with "heroId1 wins". This is not exact and the schema gives no description, so the semantics remain unverified.

winRateHeroId1.semanticNote: Does not track the pair-specific win ratio. It is observed to be constant per heroId1 across opponents within a response bucket, consistent with a hero-level aggregate; that reading is not confirmed by the schema.

winRateHeroId2.semanticNote: Does not track the pair-specific complement ratio. Observed relationships to winRateHeroId1 are descriptive only.

conclusions.basis: Partition status PROVEN_ON_SAMPLE: 32/32 complete pair-weeks; all four fields compared separately.
29 pair-weeks have rank groups with opposite signed deltas; 3 have all four groups with the same non-zero sign.
Individual bracket filters produce different deltas and threshold outcomes than the production aggregate. This describes filter dependence, not a cause.
individual:UNCALIBRATED returned pair rows for 0 pair-weeks. Empty results are not evidence that unknown-rank matches contribute zero to production.
FILTERED and ALL returned pair rows for 0 and 0 pair-weeks. The all-ranks filter equalled production counts in 32 pair-weeks; that is not proof that ALL equals the union of the production groups.

Reverse-direction matchCount differences exist inside individual rank groups as well as in the production aggregate, and the groups sum exactly to production. Nothing here identifies the mechanism that makes A→B and B→A counts differ.

rootCause.explanation: FIX13 establishes empirical additivity of the four production bracket groups and the winsAverage ≈ winCount/matchCount relation on the sample. Neither identifies why reverse-direction matchCount differs; the STRATZ API contract for these fields remains undocumented.
